summary: J-Star Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on June 8, 2026. Shareholders approved routine items including the appointment of WWC, P.C. as auditors, re-election of directors, and a share consolidation proposal that will consolidate Class A and Class B ordinary shares with a par value of US$0.50 each into shares with a par value of US$2.50 each, reducing the number of issued and authorized shares accordingly. Fractional entitlements will not be issued. This is a routine meeting report with no special-situation event.
